card.name: Statistics phrases about populations and averages
card.fires_on: Words inside news-style statistical sentences about a population, rate or average, such as 'percentage of the working age population' or 'average land temperature'. It fires on linking words and nouns that set up a group being measured.

modes.label: Rate or share phrases
modes.description: Words within 'the percentage of the working age population that is participating' in labor statistics.
modes.example: The percentage<< of>> the working age population that is participating in

modes.label: Averages and comparisons
modes.description: Words in phrases comparing an average or a region with a larger whole.
modes.example: The Arctic has been warming about twice as fast as the rest<< of>> the Northern Hemisphere

modes.label: Area or group nouns
modes.description: Nouns naming the area or group whose figures are being reported.
modes.example: The change in population of a geographic<< area>> broken down by racial and ethnic groups since

card.plain: It marks the middle of a sentence that reports a statistic about a population or an average.
